question: In week one, new sales hire Ana closes 6 of her 20 calls and Ben closes 2. Who is the better seller?
answer: Nobody can tell yet. At a true close rate of 20%, twenty calls give anywhere from 1 to 8 sales by luck alone. Kahneman and Klein agreed that a gut call becomes skill only where feedback is plentiful and clear. A first week of calls is neither, however sure it feels.
move: Give a newcomer enough tries before deciding who they are.
ask: Whom have I sized up on a first week, and how many tries did that rest on?

notes: Week one, 20 calls each: Ana 30%, Ben 10%. Built in: Ben sells better, 25% to 20%.
Ten weeks: 22% against 24%. Ben has only just drawn ahead.
Two years, 2,000 calls each: 20% against 25%. Week one picked the wrong one.

reference: Kahneman and Klein, Conditions for Intuitive Expertise: A Failure to Disagree, American Psychologist, 2009
